pixelReplay.limitation: Controlled video pixels and browser scheduling; live canvas2d drawable pixels, WebGL import, GPU cost and physical presentation require device evidence.

counterReplay.limitation: Controlled DOM/WebGL counters and source image identities; device counter timing, decoded-versus-visible frame identity, GPU execution and screen presentation require fresh evidence.

limitations: 回放使用受控DOM/WebGL与时钟；实机分项耗时和GPU执行继续由新日志取证。
旧日志的24ms总读取仍只有历史总值；新分项字段由新构建产生。
像素相等受静态画面和缩略采样影响；有效变化配对表达drawable图像变化。
